description: Java class representing a response payload for a note in the notes application; contains fields like id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt with getters and setters.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: A DTO class used to send note data as a response in the API, including metadata fields and their accessors.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the note and returns the current object for chaining.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note and returns the current object for chaining.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note and returns the current object for chaining.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the note.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the note and returns the current object for chaining.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last update timestamp of the note.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last update timestamp of the note and returns the current object for chaining.
